Slow quotes, price volatility, unpredictable lead times, and constant operational friction are still the daily reality.
We’re building a world where buyers receive firm quotes instantly, prices become balanced, deliveries are predictable, and suppliers access stable, repeat demand across Europe.
A market where procurement, logistics, and financing run in one seamless workflow – with less effort, less risk, and more transparency for everyone involved.
Instant, AI-driven pricing of material and services via phone, email, WhatsApp, or app.
End-to-end transport from origin to site, warehouse, or project location.

Andercore runs the full order process in one guided flow. Our AI system structures requests, finds the right supply, coordinates logistics and financing, and manages delivery and reordering across the entire physical chain.
Provide order details
Specifications, volumes, and timelines of buyers are captured through phone, email, WhatsApp, or app. Our team and AI agents structure the request and prepare it for sourcing.
Prices, terms, and lead times are aggregated into a single view. Our specialists are available at any time to support decision-making.
Shipments are tracked in real time. With each order, the system learns preferences and requirements, making future requests faster and more accurate.
Access, stability, efficiency, and predictable operations – all in one trusted partner.
Our AI models price every request instantly across categories. Quotes are available by phone, email, WhatsApp, or app – whatever fits your workflow.
We coordinate transport from the origin to the last mile. Deliveries go directly to your site, warehouse, or project location – fast, transparent, and reliable.
Integrated credit lines, multi-currency options, and secure payments supported by leading banks and fintech partners. Buyers gain flexibility. Suppliers gain predictable cash flow.
Predictable order volumes
We collaborate on forecasting and planning to help stabilise production and capacity.
We hire engineers, operators, and builders – people who want to solve real-world problems at scale.
Industrial materials are sourced and manufactured globally. Yet ordering, pricing, logistics, and financing still run through fragmented systems and manual processes.

Our platform gives buyers real-time access to global inventory, dynamic pricing, and managed logistics – with embedded financing. Suppliers gain direct market access and consistent demand. All orchestrated by AI, at scale, across borders.
Reasoning from First Principles
Global trade is complex by nature. Our job is to make it simple and safe – from pricing to financing to cross-border logistics. Complexity is our problem, not our customers'.
In industrial supply, trust comes from execution. We design systems that behave predictably, deliver on time, and reduce friction at every step.
Scale without compromise
Our platform handles thousands of transactions across borders, categories, and currencies – while maintaining the precision and reliability of a single deal.

We come from traders who knew firsthand how painful it was to find reliable supply, negotiate pricing, and manage cross-border delivery. We set out to build a platform that handles the operational complexity so teams can focus on their core business.
Software that handles pricing, quoting, quality assurance, and order execution autonomously

Andercore Company Profile

Andercore is an AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods, starting with energy and infrastructure, that executes trade and distribution end-to-end. It buys from global sources on its own account and delivers to project sites and warehouses across European markets.

Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, its product range covers energy materials, infrastructure components, and industrial goods: from PV modules, batteries, and inverters to steel, insulation, cables, and energy transformers.

Andercore was founded in 2021 by Philipp Andernach (fifth-generation trading family) and Elsa Cordonnier. The company is backed by Atomico, Project A, Inven Capital, and Target Global, holds a €30M revolving credit facility from UniCredit and KfW, serves more than 4,500 customers, and works with more than 2,000 international suppliers and manufacturers.
